title: Qur’an Timelessness
about: A structured, interactive digest of why the Qur’an is timeless—built from research on preservation, language, layered meanings, science hints, prophecies, its role as muhaymin, and universal ethics.

sections.title: Continuity & Final Revelation
sections.summary: The Qur’an confirms earlier revelations and guards them (muhaymin) while completing the Abrahamic message.

cards.title: Muhaymin (Guardian)
cards.text: We revealed to you the Book in truth, confirming the Scripture that came before it and as a guardian over it.
cards.takeaway: Frame the Qur’an as confirmation + criterion, not a break from earlier revelation.

cards.title: Not a New Religion
bullets: Affirms original divine origin of Torah and Gospel.
Corrects human alterations while preserving core truths.
cards.reflection: How does ‘guardian over them’ change how you view the Torah & Gospel?

cards.title: Practice
cards.text: Read 5:48 and write one sentence on how it guides your approach to interfaith conversations.

sections.title: Preservation of the Qur’an
sections.summary: A uniquely dual transmission (memorization + writing), early compilation, and unified text.

cards.title: Divine Pledge
cards.text: Indeed, We sent down the Reminder, and indeed We are its guardian.
cards.takeaway: Believers see history as fulfilling this promise.

cards.title: Dual Preservation
cards.text: From the Prophet’s lifetime: large-scale memorization (ḥifẓ) and written recording by dedicated scribes; verified before acceptance.

cards.title: Compilation Highlights
items: 632–634 CE: Abu Bakr commissions a master copy via Zayd b. Thābit with multi-witness verification.
c. 650 CE: ‘Uthmān standardizes copies for major regions; prevents variant proliferation.

cards.title: Manuscript Consistency
bullets: Early codices align in content with today’s Qur’an (orthographic differences don’t alter doctrine).
Living oral tradition cross-checks written transmission.

cards.title: Practice
cards.text: Memorize 15:9. In one paragraph, note why combined oral/written preservation matters.

sections.title: Linguistic Miracle (I‘jāz)
sections.summary: A unique register—neither poetry nor typical prose—with inimitable precision and cadence.

cards.title: Open Challenge
cards.text: If you are in doubt… produce one surah like it…
cards.takeaway: A standing invitation to test the claim.

cards.title: Unprecedented Form
bullets: Fusion of rhyme, rhythm, and rhetoric without fixed meter.
Concise yet layered phrasing; precise lexical choices.
cards.reflection: What makes a text feel ‘beyond time’ to you—form, content, or both?

cards.title: Practice
cards.text: Listen to a recitation of a short surah and journal how the sound shapes your understanding.

sections.title: Multi-Layered Meaning & Relevance
sections.summary: One verse guides the individual, family, and society—across ages.

cards.title: Justice Without Bias
cards.text: Stand firmly for justice… even against yourselves or parents.

cards.title: Universals Over Particulars
bullets: Emphasis on justice, mercy, patience, gratitude, stewardship.
Historical stories framed for general lessons (e.g., Yusuf, 12:111).

cards.title: Reflect
cards.prompt: Which Qur’anic value do you most need this week—and why?

sections.title: Scientific Hints & Consistency
sections.summary: Not a textbook—yet free of ancient myths and strikingly aligned where it speaks.

cards.title: Embryonic Stages
cards.text: We made the drop into a clinging substance (‘alaqah), then a chewed-like lump (muḍghah)…
cards.note: Presented as signs; Muslims avoid over-claiming specifics.

cards.title: Expanding Heaven
cards.text: We built the heaven with might and We are surely expanding it; the heavens and earth were once joined, then We split them asunder.

cards.title: Mountains like Pegs
cards.text: We made the mountains as pegs… set firm so it does not shake with you.

cards.title: Barriers Between Seas
cards.text: He released the two seas… between them is a barrier they do not transgress.

cards.title: Celestial Orbits
cards.text: The sun and moon each float in an orbit; the sun runs to its appointed course.

cards.title: Method Note
cards.text: These are signs to inspire reflection, not shifting ‘proofs’ tied to transient theories.

sections.title: Prophecies & Unseen
sections.summary: Specific, time-bound prophecies and unseen reports strengthen credibility.

cards.title: Roman Comeback
cards.text: The Romans have been defeated… but within three to nine years they will be victorious. On that day the believers will rejoice.

cards.title: Return to Makkah
cards.text: He who ordained the Qur’an to you will surely bring you back to the place of return.

cards.title: Reflect
cards.prompt: How do fulfilled prophecies affect your trust in unseen guidance?

sections.title: Qur’an as Guardian over Earlier Scripture
sections.summary: Confirms truth, corrects distortions, restores pure monotheism and prophet dignity.

cards.title: Confirm & Correct
bullets: Upholds shared ethics with Torah/Gospel (justice, charity, truth).

cards.title: Clarifying About Jesus
cards.text: Say not: Three. Allah is but One. The Messiah, son of Mary, was only a messenger of Allah…

sections.title: Universal Ethical & Legal Framework
sections.summary: Sharī‘ah centers on protecting faith, life, intellect, lineage, and property (maqāṣid).

cards.title: Five Essentials
bullets: Life: sanctity, just retribution with forgiveness encouraged (5:32; 2:179).
Property: fair trade, zakat, no usury (4:29; 2:275–279).

cards.title: Human Dignity & Diversity
cards.text: We created you into peoples and tribes so you may know one another… The most noble is the most righteous. We honored the children of Adam.

cards.title: Practice
cards.text: Pick one maqasid to strengthen this week and define a concrete step (e.g., reduce waste as stewardship).

sections.title: Call to Reflection
sections.summary: A living guidance inviting direct engagement.

cards.title: Internal Consistency
cards.text: Had it been from other than Allah, they would have found in it much contradiction.

cards.title: Open Invitation
cards.text: If humankind and jinn gathered to produce the like of this Qur’an, they could not produce the like of it.

cards.title: Next Step
cards.text: Read one short surah daily this week and journal a single take-away each day.
